I have only this small plot of maize, so I want to feed it well. I will get a little DAP and urea from the cooperative, and I will add cow manure that my family has collected. My son gave me improved seed, which is better than the local kind, so I will plant that. I do not have money for spray chemicals, and God sends the rain, so I will not irrigate. My daughters and I can manage the work on this small land, so I will not hire anyone.
